newsitem.title: INDIA: ITC signs agreement to licence B.A.T brand in India.
newsitem.headline: ITC signs agreement to licence B.A.T brand in India.

text.p: India's ITC Ltd signed an agreement with B.A.T Industries Plc on Monday on the licensing of the B.A.T brand to ITC, subject to the approval of the government of India, ITC said in a statement.
"B.A.T. Industries Plc and ITC Ltd have signed an agreement on licensing of B.A.T. brand to ITC, subject to the approval of the government of India," the statement said.
It did not give any more details.
Britain's B.A.T. Industries Plc has a 31.7 percent stake in ITC Ltd.
ITC, India's leading cigarette manufacturer, posted a net profit of 3.47 billion rupees ($97 million) in 1996/97 compared with 2.61 billion rupees in the previous year.
